# Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] Tests were run or the reason they were not run is documented.
- [ ] Database migrations were reviewed or this change has no migration impact.
- [ ] Authentication and session impact was reviewed.
- [ ] Privacy and personal-data inventory impact was reviewed.
- [ ] External provider impact was reviewed.
- [ ] Secret exposure risk was checked.
- [ ] Environment variable changes are documented with placeholders only.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where needed.
- [ ] Screenshots or generated evidence were reviewed for personal data.
- [ ] Rollback behavior is documented.
- [ ] Deployment risk is understood and acceptable.
